topic: MCP tool-handler arrival order across tool calls in one native generation

environment.plugin_source: local checkout at fbb8b3a plus this fix
environment.dsh_home: isolated temporary DSH_HOME; headless profile from the shipped template
environment.permission_mode: DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access, because the headless bash sandbox backend is not usable on this host

defect.user_symptom: The model called run_code nine times. The first call returned its result. The next eight calls returned the error text 'The tool handler does not match a staged result.' and the model reported that its only tool was broken.
defect.dsh_side: The dsh session recorded each run_code call and each dsh tool result. dsh executed the tools. The error reached only the native Claude turn.

root_cause: The CLI invokes the MCP tool handler as soon as it emits a tool call. dsh publishes the call ids of that turn to the bridge only after the complete native turn ends. After the first released batch the bridge was still in the released state with the previous batch in its staged map. The next handler therefore hit the released path, found no staged id, and was refused at once. The bridge refused every handler after the first batch of a generation.

pre_fix_reproduction.method: dsh --profile headless --json with the task: use the bash tool twice, echo FIRST-TOKEN then echo SECOND-TOKEN
pre_fix_reproduction.observed: call 1 completed with FIRST-TOKEN; call 2 recorded a completed dsh result SECOND-TOKEN and the model received 'The tool handler does not match a staged result.'

fix.change: wait() parks a handler that is not in the released batch instead of refusing it. expect() refuses a parked handler whose id is not in the newly published call list. The whole-batch order check and the duplicate-delivery refusal do not change.
fix.regression_tests: test/mcp-bridge.test.ts, rows O97 and O98 in docs/test-plan.md
fix.offline_result: 193 Node tests pass; npm run check passes

request_evidence: The fixed runs stored retentionAudit 'accepted' for the simple tool turns. Error-result continuations stored 'unavailable', as before.
not_measured: The ptc preset and the run_code tool in a live profile after the fix. The shipped headless profile has no agent-preset registry, so the reproduction used the standard preset and the bash tool. The desktop defect used the ptc preset and run_code. Both paths use one MCP bridge and one handler for each tool call.
Two user turns on one native generation in the desktop profile after the fix. A desktop app restart is necessary to load the fixed build.
